name: Easy Chicken Parmesan
description: Chicken breasts breaded in seasoned cornmeal, browned, then baked under spaghetti sauce and melted mozzarella.
keywords: chicken parmesan, chicken breast, mozzarella, baked
recipeIngredient: 4 boneless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness
Cornmeal sprinkled with Italian seasoning to desire/taste

recipeInstructions.name: Set up the breading
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk together 1 egg and 1/2 cup milk. Prepare cornmeal seasoned with Italian seasoning to taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 2 to 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Dip the 4 chicken breasts in the egg mixture, then in the seasoned cornmeal. Brown in the hot oil on both sides until golden, about 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Don't crowd the chicken; cook in batches if necessary. Set the chicken in a baking dish.

recipeInstructions.name: Top
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Put 2 slices of mozzarella (8 in all) on each chicken breast. Pour 1 jar (16 oz) spaghetti sauce over all. Sprinkle with Parmesan and a little more mozzarella.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Bake at 350°F for about 25 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly.
Serve with spaghetti, garlic bread and a green salad.
